name: Geographe

climate: Cabernet Sauvignon sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: A region in the South West Australia zone of Western Australia. Shiraz leads plantings at 21 percent, followed by Sauvignon Blanc (19), Chardonnay (17), Cabernet Sauvignon (13) and Semillon (11).

sources.name: Fick and Hijmans 2017, WorldClim 2.1 monthly averages for 1970 to 2000, 2.5 minute grid (about 4.5 km)
Beck et al. 2023, High-resolution (1 km) Koppen-Geiger maps, Scientific Data (1991 to 2020)
Winkler, Cook, Kliewer and Lider 1974, General Viticulture, University of California Press (heat summation regions)
Jones 2010, Climate, grapes, and wine: structure and suitability in a variable and changing climate, VIII International Terroir Congress (which grapes suit which growing season temperatures)
Anderson, Nelgen and Puga, Database of Regional, National and Global Winegrape Bearing Areas by Variety, 2000 to 2023, University of Adelaide (CC BY 4.0)
AWS Terrain Tiles (Terrarium), from SRTM, GMTED2010, ETOPO1 and national elevation models
Wikipedia, Lapse rate (6.5 °C cooler per 1,000 m, the standard atmosphere)
Wine Australia, Geographical Indications of Australia (zones, regions and subregions), CC BY 4.0
OpenStreetMap contributors, rivers and lakes named on the page (Overpass API), ODbL 1.0
